recurring_events.title: Mid-year AIS / 26AS reconciliation
recurring_events.details: Reconcile AIS and Form 26AS against CAS and broker P&L. Treat mismatches as reconciliation flags — not evasion.

recurring_events.title: Pre-filing AIS / Tax Firewall review
recurring_events.details: Full Tax Firewall pass before return preparation. Resolve open mismatches with supporting documents.

recurring_events.title: Nominee gap audit (H1)
recurring_events.details: Review nominee coverage across demat, bank, insurance, and entity holdings. Instruction-only Action Cards for gaps.

recurring_events.title: Nominee gap audit (H2)
recurring_events.details: Second-half nominee audit across the entity web.

recurring_events.title: Tax-loss harvest window review
recurring_events.details: Pair STCG/LTCG loss lots against gains. Execute sells on broker externally — CAPSTONE provides pairing instructions only.

recurring_events.title: Property capital gains / exemption pathway review
recurring_events.details: Review Section 54 / 54EC / 54F pathways for RE exits. Consult CA before structuring.

recurring_events.title: MCA / company hygiene check
recurring_events.details: Flag ROC filings, DIN KYC, and board resolution hygiene for pvt ltd entities. Suggestion only — escalate to CA/CS.

recurring_events.title: FEMA / LRS / residential status review
recurring_events.details: Review LRS usage, overseas assets, and residential status changes. Escalate to CA for execution.

recurring_events.title: Entity-web annual planning memo
recurring_events.details: Review person / HUF / trust / company allocation, clubbing risk, and gift/settlement plans. Mode B — consult CA.

recurring_events.title: TDS / TCS credit reconciliation
recurring_events.details: Match TDS/TCS credits in 26AS to ledger. Claim shortfalls via correction paths with your CA.

signal_rules.title: Open Tax Firewall mismatches need attention
signal_rules.details: Portfolio shows open AIS/ledger mismatches. Reconcile before advance tax and filing windows.
